messages.subject: Re: path models and CFA with non-normal data
parts: I've seen the overview of estimators but am not sure which one would be suitable.

If your sample size is several thousand large, then you can use estimator = "WLS", which is also known as ADF estimation.
For more realistically modest sample sizes, you can use estimator = "MLM" (only available with complete data) or "MLR" (also available with incomplete data in combination with missing = "FIML").
